parameters.name: ApiName
parameters.description: The name of the API. The name is used for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**
*   **TEST**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-api-histories --group-id 1084f9034c744137901057206b39d2b6 --stage-name RELEASE --api-id c076144d7878437b8f82fb85890ce6a0 --api-name weather --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeApiHistories --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --StageName RELEASE --ApiName weather --PageNumber 1 --ApiId c076144d7878437b8f82fb85890ce6a0 --GroupId 1084f9034c744137901057206b39d2b6
